title: Recover an Unhealthy Indexer Cluster
objectives: Verify actual state through a separate inspection or query.

tasks.instruction: The cluster starts with maintenance enabled and a wrong manager_uri on idx03. Diagnose running configuration and bucket coverage rather than restarting every node.

Repair idx03, restart that peer and disable manager maintenance. Advance fixup until all peers are joined and RF/SF are met. Inspect splunk show cluster-status on cm01 and independently search all three records.

hints: Inspect running versus disk source and use the correct component.
Keep the fixture clock paused and advance deliberately to observe transitions.

references.purpose: Searchable restart and available copy preflight
Deployer source, target and merge_to_default behavior
Collection schema and data endpoint families; virtual execution boundary documented

checks.label: Actual joined peers and searchable bucket coverage

feedback.success: Verified operational state and independent evidence are retained in this isolated attempt.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect current source, service state, operation receipts and replica data.
